layman_headline: The crypto market is bleeding and scared — now is the time to watch, not chase.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market is in a state of fear, with Bitcoin dropping over 4% in a week and most altcoins falling even harder. Major news headlines are bearish: Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) is selling Bitcoin, a hardware wallet exploit is ongoing, and Bitcoin futures yields have collapsed below Treasury note rates. While a couple of coins like TRUMP and PENGU show oversold readings that historically lead to bounces, the broader market structure is too weak and uncertain to justify putting money to work right now.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. The market is fearful but not panicking enough for a high-conviction contrarian entry. Watch for Bitcoin to find a clear support level or for the Fear and Greed Index to drop below 20, which would signal extreme panic and a better buying opportunity. Do not chase any of the coins that have already pumped (like UB) or try to catch falling knives in a downtrend.
expert_reasoning: Systematic analysis of all 7 candidates reveals no actionable setup. UB has the only bullish chart (+1.10 bias) but has already rallied 29% with a risk/reward of only 0.49x — chasing momentum in a fearful market is a losing strategy. TRUMP and PENGU both show RSI oversold readings (26 and 27 respectively), which per signal credibility data is our most reliable indicator (71% win rate). However, both are in confirmed downtrends with bearish chart structures, below all moving averages, and in a macro environment where BTC dominance at 56.2% is crushing altcoins. The Fear & Greed at 28 with a worsening trend suggests more downside is possible. Per my validated Rule #3, when F&G is near 25, the short-term outlook is genuinely ambiguous and holding is the safest call. Multiple bearish news catalysts — Strategy selling BTC, Coldcard exploit, futures yield collapse — reinforce caution. The CLARITY Act Senate deadline creates additional regulatory uncertainty.
risk_factors: Bitcoin could break below $60,000 support if Strategy continues liquidating, which would drag all altcoins down further
The Coldcard hardware wallet exploit is now in its fifth day with no resolution, potentially undermining broader crypto confidence
Senate failure to pass the CLARITY Act by Friday could create regulatory overhang on all crypto assets
watch_list: Bitcoin's reaction at the $60,000 psychological support level — a clean bounce would create entry setups across the board
Fear and Greed Index — if it drops below 20 (extreme fear), historically that has been a better contrarian entry zone
Senate CLARITY Act vote by Friday — passage could trigger a relief rally, failure could extend the selloff
market_context: The crypto market is in a broad risk-off phase with Bitcoin down 4.2% weekly, futures yields collapsing below Treasury rates, and institutional sellers (Strategy) adding supply pressure. Fear & Greed at 28 and worsening suggests we haven't reached capitulation yet.
context_banner: Market in fear-driven decline with multiple bearish catalysts — patience is the highest-conviction trade right now.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 28 with worsening weekly trend (avg 27.6) — market is fearful but not yet at extreme panic levels that historically mark bottoms.
TRUMP (26.2) and PENGU (27.0) both oversold, which is our most reliable signal (71% win rate), but both are in bearish chart structures that undermine the bounce thesis.
Strategy selling more BTC and Bitcoin futures yields collapsing below Treasury notes signal institutional risk-off positioning and reduced speculative appetite.
'Bitcoin may find bear market bottom in August' from 10x Research suggests we may be early in the bottoming process rather than at the bottom.
Senate has 5 days to pass CLARITY Act — binary outcome creates uncertainty that makes new entries risky until resolution.
